name: Shokz OpenSwim bone-conduction swimming headphones
description: The crowd favorite for a reason. Bone conduction plus onboard storage means no phone and no dropouts, the wraparound band stays put through flip turns, and it's fully waterproof.

name: FINIS team swim cap in silicone or latex
description: The smart buy for a team, a family, or anyone who loses caps constantly. Team packs in silicone or cheaper latex cover the basics without the per-cap premium.

name: Speedo Team Pull Buoy
description: The bulk-bin workhorse — cheap, durable, and perfectly functional. It survives being thrown in a bag, stepped on, and left in a hot car all summer, which is why clubs buy it by the dozen.

name: TYR Junior and Standard Pull Float
description: The one to buy when a standard buoy has always sat wrong. Clearly sized options let you match the float to your body, so it doesn't shove a smaller swimmer too high or leave a bigger swimmer's legs dragging.
